# NeuromorphicVisionPipeline

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
An integrated hardware-software pipeline that uses spiking neural networks to process visual data in real-time for robotic perception, bypassing traditional frame-based processing. Enables low-latency, energy-efficient visual processing critical for interactive robotics in resource-constrained edge environments.
